name: first-forward-dashboard
description: First Forward + GV Partner FASTag dashboards — login-protected issuance, stock, trend, performance and GV-vs-FF comparison from two Google Sheets, with animated login, forgot-password flow, per-user/per-sheet access matrix and downloadable Excel/CSV.

scripts.check: set -e; node --check server.js && node --check sheets-storage.js && node --check apps-script-storage.js && node --check sw.js && for f in config util xlsx data charts model store gv preload auth notifications sheets dashboard trend stock performance home gvpages compare tagIssued chartExplorer kpiDetail liveView settings targets rangeReport insights app palette tv map; do node --check "$f.js" || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok
